title: The Day the Middle Ages Ended
sentences: Many historians mark the end of the Middle Ages with one day in 1453.
On May 29, Constantinople fell to the Ottoman Empire.
It ended the last state that traced itself straight back to ancient Rome.
Some define the Middle Ages as the time between the fall of Rome in the West and the fall of Rome in the East.
Others pick different dates, like Columbus's voyage in 1492.
Either way, 1453 is one of history's great turning points.
